purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: law lecture; vocabulary (攻撃/禁止/否定/積極/事情/相当) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国際法は、一方的な攻撃を禁止します。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 禁止を、破る国もあるんですか?
lines.en: Are there nations that break the ban?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、相当な数の例があります。
lines.en: Yes, there are a considerable number of cases.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 攻撃を、否定する国もありますね。
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 否定しても、証拠が相当残ります。
lines.en: Even if denied, considerable evidence remains.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 禁止を守らせるのは、難しいですね。
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 積極的な協力が、相当に重要です。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 攻撃を防ぐ仕組み、学びたいです。
lines.en: I want to learn the system that prevents attacks.
lines.style: resolved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
